youtube.title: Plane Ki Window Mein Chhota Sa Hole Kyun Hota Hai? 🤔 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Agli baar flight mein baitho, to window ko dhyan se dekho. Neeche ki taraf ek chhota sa hole milega. Dekhne mein crack jaisa lagta hai, par yeh crack nahi hai.

Plane ki window mein teen panes hote hain, aur hole beech wale pane mein hota hai. Yeh hole pressure ko bahar wale pane tak pahunchata hai, aur moisture ko bhi nikalta hai, taaki window par fog na jame. Ek chhota sa hole, har flight mein chupchap poori window ko kaam karta rakhta hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
